title: Accept ADRs 0060–0067, the foundation designs
body: 0060 extension registry and 0061 component data (built in 0.5); 0062 v2 stream and document grammar, 0063 property methods from records, 0064 an N-phase flash that discovers phases (0.5–0.6); 0065 the unit-model framework, 0066 dynamic problems and run kinds, 0067 v2 identity and replay (0.6–0.7). All were reviewed and fixed; each amends the frozen application contract additively, so each needs your yes.

Two reviewer defaults inside 0067/0065: S1, older v2 bundles re-run after a built-in unit changes and report differences (instead of refusing); S7, retiring a legacy unit family affects only revisions built by the new compiler.

options.label: Keep them Proposed for now
options.detail: The next designs build on them as written.
